F2.quote: As part of the collaboration with the Laboratório de Estudos Literários Avançados (ELAB), the foundation was laid for a digital edition of the editorial projects and publications of the Portuguese author Fernando Pessoa (1888–1935); Ulrike Henny was responsible for this at the CCeH.

F6.claim: editors: Ulrike Henny-Krahmer, Pedro Sepúlveda, Jorge Uribe; other participants on the edition's team page

F8.quote: She continues to edit the edition, together with Pedro Sepúlveda (Lisbon) and Jorge Uribe (Medellín). Since the end of the project phase, in which the CCeH was directly involved, the cooperation has also been extended to the EAFIT University in Medellín (Colombia).
F8.claim: Henny continues to edit it with Sepúlveda and Uribe; after the CCeH's phase the cooperation extended to EAFIT University, Medellín
F8.lineage: genealogy: the framework project, the start, the launch, the cooperations

F9.quote: Above all, handwritten notes, lists and plans with which Pessoa conceived his work are edited. These will be juxtaposed with his works published during his lifetime in order to trace the development of Pessoa’s oeuvre between planning and publication.
F9.claim: what it edits: above all Pessoa's handwritten notes, lists and plans, juxtaposed with his works published in his lifetime, to trace his oeuvre between planning and publication
F9.lineage: what it edits: Pessoa's notes, lists and plans beside his published works

F10.quote: The edition contains text transcriptions in TEI, facsimiles, indexes of persons, journals and titles, as well as various visualizations of the data (timelines and a network of persons).
F10.claim: holdings: TEI transcriptions, facsimiles, indexes of persons, journals and titles, timelines and a network of persons

F11.quote: Technically, the edition is based on an eXist database and uses XQuery and XSLT scripts as well as JavaSript to create the publication.
F11.claim: method: an eXist database, XQuery and XSLT scripts and JavaScript ('JavaSript' as printed)
